task: Write a follow-up email (80–120 words) to the manager who interviewed you yesterday for a systems engineer job. Thank her, mention one thing you enjoyed talking about, and say you are still keen.
zh: 给昨天面试你系统工程师职位的经理写一封跟进邮件（80–120 词）。感谢她，提到一个你聊得很投入的话题，并表示你仍然很想要这份工作。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your manager asking for two days of leave for a friend's wedding in Queenstown. Give the dates and say how your work will be covered.
zh: 给经理写一封邮件（80–120 词），请两天假去皇后镇参加朋友的婚礼。写明日期，并说明你的工作怎么安排。

task: Write an apology email (80–120 words) to a customer whose website was down for two hours yesterday. Say what happened in simple words, say sorry, and say what you have done to stop it happening again.
zh: 给一位客户写一封道歉邮件（80–120 词），他的网站昨天中断了两小时。用简单的话说明发生了什么，道歉，并说明你们做了什么来防止再次发生。

task: Write a complaint email (80–120 words) to an online shop. The headphones you ordered arrived with a broken left side. Give the order details, describe the problem, and say what you want them to do.
zh: 给一家网店写一封投诉邮件（80–120 词）。你订的耳机到货时左边是坏的。写明订单信息，描述问题，并说明你希望他们怎么处理。

task: Write a thank-you email (80–120 words) to a colleague who trained you during your first month. Name two things she taught you and say how they help you now.
zh: 给在你入职第一个月带你的同事写一封感谢邮件（80–120 词）。说出她教你的两件事，以及它们现在对你有什么帮助。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to the IT helpdesk. Your laptop battery now lasts only one hour. Say when it started, what you have tried, and how it affects your work.
zh: 给 IT 服务台写一封邮件（80–120 词）。你的笔记本电池现在只能用一小时。说明从什么时候开始、你试过什么办法，以及对工作的影响。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your landlord. The heat pump has stopped working and winter is coming. Describe the problem and ask for a repair date.
zh: 给房东写一封邮件（80–120 词）。热泵空调坏了，而冬天快到了。描述问题，并请对方给出维修日期。

task: Write a post (80–120 words) for your local community Facebook group. Your cat has been missing since Tuesday. Describe the cat, where it was last seen, and how people can contact you.
zh: 在本地社区的 Facebook 群里写一个帖子（80–120 词）。你的猫从周二起就不见了。描述猫的样子、最后出现的地点，以及大家怎么联系你。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a plumber asking for a quote. You want a new hot water cylinder put in. Describe the old one, where it is, and when they could visit.
zh: 给水管工写一封邮件（80–120 词）询问报价。你想换一个新的热水缸。描述旧的那个、它的位置，以及对方什么时候可以上门。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a hotel in Wellington. You need to move your booking one day later. Give your booking details, the new dates, and ask if the price changes.
zh: 给惠灵顿的一家酒店写一封邮件（80–120 词）。你需要把预订往后推一天。提供预订信息和新的日期，并问价格会不会变。

task: Write a follow-up email (80–120 words) to your team after this morning's planning meeting. List three action items, who owns each one, and the due date.
zh: 今天上午的计划会议之后，给团队写一封跟进邮件（80–120 词）。列出三项待办事项、各自的负责人和截止日期。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your bank. There is a $89 charge on your card that you do not recognise. Give the date and name on the charge and ask them to look into it.
zh: 给银行写一封邮件（80–120 词）。你的卡上有一笔 89 元的扣款你不认识。写明扣款日期和商户名称，请他们调查。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your gym to cancel your membership. Give your reason, the date you want it to end, and ask them to confirm the last payment.
zh: 给健身房写一封邮件（80–120 词）取消会员。说明原因和希望终止的日期，并请他们确认最后一笔扣费。

task: Write a post (80–120 words) for the all-staff channel about planned maintenance on Saturday night. Say which systems will be off, for how long, and what staff should do before then.
zh: 在全员频道写一个帖子（80–120 词），通知周六晚上的计划维护。说明哪些系统会停、停多久，以及员工事先需要做什么。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your city council to report a deep pothole on your street. Say exactly where it is, why it is dangerous, and ask when it will be fixed.
zh: 给市议会写一封邮件（80–120 词），报告你家街上的一个深坑。说明确切位置、为什么危险，并问什么时候能修好。

task: Write a message (80–120 words) to a friend to say sorry for missing their birthday party. Explain honestly what happened and offer to make it up to them.
zh: 给朋友写一条消息（80–120 词），为错过他们的生日聚会道歉。如实解释原因，并提出怎么补偿。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a software supplier. Your licence ends next month. Ask for the renewal price for 50 users and whether there is a discount for three years.
zh: 给一家软件供应商写一封邮件（80–120 词）。你们的许可证下个月到期。询问 50 个用户的续费价格，以及签三年有没有折扣。

task: Write a post (80–120 words) to sell your couch on a local buy-and-sell page. Describe its size, age and condition, give the price, and say how to pick it up.
zh: 在本地的二手买卖页面写一个帖子（80–120 词）卖你的沙发。描述尺寸、使用年限和成色，给出价格，并说明怎么取货。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your medical centre. Ask for a repeat prescription and for the results of last week's blood test. Give the details they need to find your record.
zh: 给你的医疗中心写一封邮件（80–120 词）。请他们续开处方，并询问上周验血的结果。提供他们查找你档案所需的信息。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a senior colleague asking her to be your mentor. Say why you chose her, what you want to learn, and how much time you are asking for.
zh: 给一位资深同事写一封邮件（80–120 词），请她做你的导师。说明为什么选她、你想学什么，以及需要她花多少时间。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to an airline. Your suitcase did not arrive in Christchurch. Give your flight, describe the bag, and say where to send it.
zh: 给航空公司写一封邮件（80–120 词）。你的行李箱没有到达基督城。写明航班、描述箱子，并说明送到哪里。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your manager asking the company to pay for a cloud certification course. Say what it costs and how it will help the team.
zh: 给经理写一封邮件（80–120 词），请公司出钱让你上一门云认证课程。说明费用，以及它对团队有什么帮助。

task: Write a thank-you message (80–120 words) to a Kiwi family who invited you to a barbecue at their bach. Say what you enjoyed most and invite them to your place.
zh: 给邀请你去他们度假小屋烧烤的新西兰家庭写一条感谢消息（80–120 词）。说说你最喜欢什么，并邀请他们来你家。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a restaurant to book a team lunch for twelve people. Give the date and time, mention two food needs (for example vegetarian, no nuts), and ask about a set menu.
zh: 给一家餐厅写一封邮件（80–120 词），预订十二人的团队午餐。写明日期和时间，提到两项饮食要求（比如素食、不含坚果），并询问有没有套餐。

task: Write a complaint email (80–120 words) to your power company. This month's bill is double the usual amount, but nothing changed at home. Ask them to check the meter reading.
zh: 给电力公司写一封投诉邮件（80–120 词）。这个月的账单是平时的两倍，但家里没有任何变化。请他们核对电表读数。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to someone in another team asking for read access to the sales database. Say why you need it, for how long, and who approved it.
zh: 给另一个团队的同事写一封邮件（80–120 词），申请销售数据库的只读权限。说明为什么需要、需要多久，以及谁批准的。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a theatre school asking about their beginner improv class. Ask about the price, the class size, and whether it suits someone whose first language is not English.
zh: 给一所戏剧学校写一封邮件（80–120 词），询问他们的即兴表演入门班。问价格、班级人数，以及是否适合母语不是英语的人。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a customer to say the project will be finished one week late. Give the reason, the new date, and what you are doing to keep to it.
zh: 给客户写一封邮件（80–120 词），告知项目将延迟一周完成。说明原因、新的日期，以及你们为保证新日期所做的努力。

task: Write a post (80–120 words) to introduce yourself in an online group for weekend walkers. Say who you are, how fit you are, and ask to join the next walk.
zh: 在一个周末徒步爱好者的线上群里写一个自我介绍的帖子（80–120 词）。说说你是谁、体能怎么样，并请求参加下一次徒步。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your car insurance company. Someone scratched your car in a supermarket car park. Say when and where it happened and ask how to make a claim.
zh: 给你的车险公司写一封邮件（80–120 词）。有人在超市停车场刮了你的车。说明时间和地点，并问怎么理赔。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to politely turn down a job offer. Thank the company, give a short honest reason, and leave the door open for the future.
zh: 写一封邮件（80–120 词）礼貌地拒绝一个工作邀请。感谢对方公司，简短如实地说明原因，并为将来留有余地。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your property manager to give notice that you are moving out. Give your last day, ask about the final inspection, and ask how you get your bond back.
zh: 给物业经理写一封邮件（80–120 词），通知你要搬走。写明最后一天，询问退房检查，并问押金怎么退。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a local Toastmasters club asking to come as a guest. Say why you want to join, ask when and where they meet, and ask what a guest should expect.
zh: 给本地的 Toastmasters 俱乐部写一封邮件（80–120 词），请求以来宾身份参加。说明你为什么想加入，问他们的活动时间和地点，以及来宾需要了解什么。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a colleague to say sorry for speaking sharply to him in a meeting. Say what you should have done and how you want to work together from now on.
zh: 给同事写一封邮件（80–120 词），为你在会上对他说话太冲道歉。说说你本该怎么做，以及今后希望怎样合作。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a courier company. The tracking page says your parcel was delivered, but it is not at your door. Give the tracking details and ask them to find it.
zh: 给快递公司写一封邮件（80–120 词）。物流页面显示包裹已送达，但你门口并没有。提供单号信息，请他们查找。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your old manager asking her to be a referee for a job you are applying for. Remind her what you worked on together and tell her about the new role.
zh: 给你的前经理写一封邮件（80–120 词），请她为你申请的新工作做推荐人。提醒她你们一起做过什么，并介绍一下新职位。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) inviting your team to a shared lunch on Friday. Say where and when, ask everyone to bring a dish from their own culture, and say what you will bring.
zh: 写一封邮件（80–120 词）邀请团队参加周五的共享午餐。说明时间地点，请每个人带一道自己文化的菜，并说你会带什么。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to a garage. Your car needs a Warrant of Fitness and makes a strange noise when you brake. Describe the noise and ask for a booking next week.
zh: 给修车厂写一封邮件（80–120 词）。你的车需要做 WOF 车检，而且刹车时有奇怪的声音。描述这个声音，并预约下周的时间。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to payroll. Your last payslip is missing eight hours of overtime. Give the dates you worked and ask when it will be corrected.
zh: 给薪资部门写一封邮件（80–120 词）。你上一张工资单少算了八小时加班。写明加班日期，并问什么时候能更正。

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to an old friend overseas inviting them to visit you in New Zealand this summer. Suggest the best month and two things you would do together.
zh: 给一位在国外的老朋友写一封邮件（80–120 词），邀请他们今年夏天来新西兰看你。建议最合适的月份，以及你们可以一起做的两件事。
